{{nihongo|'''Mishima Shrine (Minamiizu)'''|三島神社 (南伊豆町妻良)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

'''Mishima Shrine''' (みしまじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in Mera, {{ill|Minamiizu|Q1203741|qid=Q1203741}}, {{ill|Kamo District, Shizuoka|Q961511|qid=Q961511}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}<ref>[http://www.shizuoka-jinjacho.or.jp/shokai/jinja.php?id=4401082 三島神社] - 静岡県神社庁</ref>.

=== Overview ===
It is enshrined on the west side along {{ill|Japan National Route 136|af|Japan Nasionale Roete 136|ja|国道136号|zh_min_nan|Ji̍t-pún Kok-tō 136-hō|qid=Q11421406}}, south of the Mera district in western Minamiizu.

Its founding is unknown, but it is an old shrine identified with the {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} '''Ōtsuyuki-no-Mikoto Shrine''' (おおつのゆきのみことじんじゃ), and it is also recorded in the ''{{ill|Izu no Kuni Shinkaichō|Q17193087|qid=Q17193087}}'' as "Junior Fourth Rank Upper, Otsuyukihime no Myōjin"<ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/misima9_title.htm 三島神社] - 玄松子</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140138-01.html 三島神社] - 延喜式神社の調査</ref>.

In {{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}} (Meiji 6), it was ranked as a village shrine<ref name="engi"/>.

=== Enshrined deity ===
* Ōtsuyuki-no-Mikoto (おおつのゆきのみこと)
